description: jQuery UI iPad plugin for touch event simulation and gesture handling, including double tap, long press, and right click emulation.

methods.name: cancelTap
methods.description: Cancels the tap validation, preventing double tap detection.

methods.name: cancelHold
methods.description: Cancels the hold (long press) timeout and resets right click pending state.

methods.name: startHold
methods.description: Initiates a hold timeout to emulate right click after 800ms.

methods.name: doRightClick
methods.description: Simulates right click and context menu events on the target element.

methods.name: iPadTouchStart
methods.description: Handles touch start event, dispatching mouseover and mousedown events, and managing double tap detection.

methods.name: getDOMElementFromEvent
methods.description: Retrieves the DOM element at the touch point.

methods.name: iPadTouchHandler
methods.description: Main handler for touch events, dispatching corresponding mouse events and managing gesture emulation.
